title: Te Reo Pono o Ngā Wā Onamata
intro: He wairua kei roto i te Quran e kōrerotia ana tana kōrero i roto i ētahi whiti torutoru noa iho, engari e tiaho ana ōna āhuatanga rangatira me te māramatanga nui. E whakanuia ana e te Atua Kaha Rawa mō tētahi āhuatanga motuhake, kei tēnei pononga tawhito a te Atua Aroha Rawa tētahi tūranga i roto i ngā whārangi o te whakakitenga. Ko tāu mahi he tautuhi i tēnei tangata whakamiharo. Ka taea e koe te matapae ko wai rātou?
clues: He poropiti ahau nā Allah i noho i roto i ngā whakatipuranga tōmua o te tangata.
I whakahuatia ahau e Allah i roto i Tāna Pukapuka me ētahi atu poropiti, e whakamoemititia ana mō te mana rangatira kotahi.
E whakaahuatia ana ahau hei tangata pono i roto i te Quran.
I whakaarahia ahau e Atua ki tētahi tūranga teitei kāore i ekehia e ētahi atu.
Kua whakahuatia tōku ingoa i roto i a Surah Al-Anbiya, i roto i te rōpū o ētahi atu poropiti e rua i whakanuia mō tō rāua manawanui.
Ko Idris ahau, te poropiti pono, te poropiti rangatira.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Poropiti Idris
Poropiti a Noa
Poropiti Ihāperama
Poropiti a Mohi
Poropiti a Ihimaera

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Kia mau ki te manawanui me te pono, kātahi ka hikitia ki te tūranga teitei
Te hanga i tētahi āka nui hei whakaora i te hunga whakapono i te waipuke nui
Ka maka ki roto i te ahi mura, ka puta mai me te kore e whara
Te tū atu ki tētahi kīngi kaha, me te hinga i tana ope o ngā tohunga makutu
E ora tonu ana i roto i te puku o te ika nui i te hohonutanga o te moana
trial.answer: Kia mau ki te manawanui me te pono, kātahi ka hikitia ki te tūranga teitei

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He tūranga teitei, he tūranga whakahīhī hoki i te aroaro o Allah
He kaipuke nui i hangaia mai i ngā papa, ā, i pania ki te uku
He ahi mura i whakakāhia e ngā kaikarakia whakapakoko o te kingi kino
He moana nui e wehea ana hei ara maroke
Te puku pōuri o te tohorā nui i te takere o te moana
location.answer: He tūranga teitei, he tūranga whakahīhī hoki i te aroaro o Allah

outcome.label: Hua
options: Kua whakaurua ki roto i te aroha noa o Allah hei tetahi o te hunga tika
I whakaorangia me te hunga whakapono katoa i te waipuke o te ao katoa
I puta atu i roto i te mura ahi, kāore i pāngia e te ahi
Ārahi haumaru ana i ngā tamariki a Iharaira ki te herekoretanga i tērā taha o te moana
I hoki anō ki tō rātou whānau aroha i muri i ngā tau roa o te uauatanga
outcome.answer: Kua whakaurua ki roto i te aroha noa o Allah hei tetahi o te hunga tika

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
